The '''VerveGen Corporation building''' was the headquarters of the [[VerveGen Corporation]] in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. In [[3643 BBY]] the building was infiltrated by [[Cipher Nine]] and [[Kaliyo Djannis]], who interrupted a meeting between VerveGen leadership and the [[Eagle]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The VerveGen Corporation building appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
